static_traits.name: Zhu Li娅
static_traits.social_status: 有少数朋友可倾诉，但因持续寻求关于乐队动态的保证而Relationship tension、交流受影响
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness，既往not yet接受心理治疗或精神卫生服务
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能自我Reflection，配合度高；情绪呈紧张但积极的态度，叙述逻辑性较好

basic_info.main_problem: 我觉得自己是一个糟糕的粉丝，认为我最喜欢的乐队 Nightfish 的解散是由我的负面想法和行为导致的，因此每天都在为此自责与内疚，并出现加重的Anxiety。
basic_info.core_demands: 我想能够参与严肃的交流并更好地承担责任；我也想停止把Humor当作拐杖，感到更充实。
growth_experiences: 在青少年时期开始在面对压力或重要情境时用Humor来缓解Anxiety、避免被评价的模式；这一应对方式延续至今，近期在工作会议与室友互动中愈加明显，导致他人认为她not够认真、难以建立更深的连接。

core_beliefs: My negative thoughts and behavior will cause bad things to happen

special_situations.event: Hearing rumors that Nightfish might disband
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我作为粉丝产生负面想法或做了not够好的事，乐队就会受到影响甚至解散
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not停在网上搜寻信息与求证、监控消息以试图阻止坏事发生
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is all my fault，是我让他们要解散

special_situations.event: Band members hinting at tension in social media or interviews
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果出现紧张迹象，就意味着解散not可避免
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加倍关注新闻与动态，反复刷新以确认他们have not要解散
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will definitely fall apart and disband soon

special_situations.event: When listening to Nightfish's music or reading related news
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 好粉丝not该有负面想法；如果我一边关注他们一边有负面想法，就说明我是坏粉丝
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Labels herself an 'I am a bad fan' and blames herself, trying to use guilt to urge herself to 'correct' it
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我就是个糟糕的粉丝，什么都做not好

special_situations.event: 在工作中的重要会议里感到Anxiety、担心被他人评价
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not说笑话、认真发言，大家会认为我not胜任或说错话会被嘲笑
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 用HumorDisplacement注意、避免表达严肃观点以逃避可能的评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得我not专业，我若认真发言一定会出丑

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be accepted and affirmed by others, to be taken seriously and seen as a 'good fan/good colleague'
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of negative evaluation, of being blamed for causing bad outcomes for others or the group (such as the band breaking up)
defense_goal: 通过Humor保持安全距离以避免他人评判
通过过度研究与求证来获得控制感、降低not确定性与Anxiety
以自责与内疚来维持对局面的“掌控”并试图弥补Anxiety

object_relations.object_representation: A band that is fragile, easily affected by self, and may fall apart at any time

object_relations.self_representation: 容易被质疑、not被认真对待的同事
object_relations.object_representation: 严苛的评判者（同事/主管），随时会negate自己

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor guides into more serious/more emotional topics or asks to concretely explore responsibility and contribution
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 若not用Humor保护自己，就会被当场评判或暴露“without能”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以轻松玩笑口吻回应，Displacement到not相关的轻松话题，减少情绪表达与眼神接触。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被询问感受与内在体验，而外界信息not确定（如传闻与线索相互矛盾）
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为必须先弄清所有事实数据，否则表达感受会显得not可靠或被negate
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Answers by listing information and deducing from data, reducing subjective emotional words, with a calm, analytical tone.

manifestations: Takes excessive personal responsibility for external events (whether the band breaks up)
Treats others' evaluations as important references; fears negative judgment
通过Humor回避真实表达与选择，降低对Freedom与责任的Anxiety
outcomes: 持续的内疚与自我责备

manifestations: Living alone且难以向朋友袒露真实信念与担忧
Uses jokes to maintain superficial interaction, reduces real contact
outcomes: 关系连接感降低与体验流于表面
支持系统难以被有效利用
情感体验受限、Increased subjective sense of isolation

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: 在严肃话题或重要会议中以开玩笑方式Displacement注意
在咨询中以Humor化解not适，减少情绪直面
谈及Anxiety时迅速切换到轻松话题

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 假定他人认为自己not胜任或会嘲笑自己
将可能的负面评价归于他人意图（如同事/主管not把自己当回事）

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequently blaming oneself as a 'bad fan', rigid self-demands
在表达观点前过度审查与克制，担心被negate

positive_force: High self-awareness; can clearly describe problem patterns and impacts
Positive attitude, willing to try new ways of contact and behavioral experiments
Has a certain degree of social support (a few friends) and a stable life structure (working from home, caring for pets)
negative_force: Excessive personalized attribution and self-blame (blaming external events on oneself)
灾难化与仓促下结论（对乐队动态的负面Anticipation）
持续的在线求证与过度研究维持Anxiety与not确定感
对他人评价高度敏感，用Humor回避真实接触，妨碍有效沟通

target_behavior.behavior: Over-researches band dynamics and repeatedly seeks reassurance online
antecedent: Hearing rumors that Nightfish might disband
Sees messages or posts from members hinting at tense relationships
target_behavior.core_reason: 将外部事件个体化归因，试图通过信息控制来缓解not确定性与Anxiety
target_behavior.function: 逃避not确定带来的Anxiety、获得短暂的安全感与控制感
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety被维持与加剧，工作与日常生活（阅读、照料宠物）受干扰

target_behavior.behavior: 在严肃场合以Humor回避认真表达与承担责任
antecedent: 工作中的重要会议或任务分配
Situations requiring serious communication with roommates or others
Occasions where one feels about to be evaluated or might 'say the wrong thing'
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕被负面评价与显得not胜任，用Humor作为防御与回避策略
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的羞耻与评判，降低当下Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 被认为not够认真，影响工作绩效与信任度；人际连接流于表面、难以深入

target_behavior.behavior: 每日自责与内疚的反复自我言语
antecedent: 阅读与乐队相关的信息
回想、联想到传闻或紧张迹象
target_behavior.core_reason: The core belief 'I am a bad fan' and 'my negative thoughts will cause bad things' triggers self-labeling and overgeneralization
target_behavior.function: 通过自责来获得“弥补”与控制的错觉，试图降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 情绪痛苦（Anxiety, shame、内疚）加重，注意力受损与功能下降（工作、人际、日常）
